gloss_en: Shevarim (שְׁבָרִים) — the series of broken, moaning shofar blasts sounded on Rosh HaShanah (one of the three shofar sounds alongside tekiah and teruah), homiletically linked by Rabbi Nachman to the roots שבר/שֵׂבֶר: trust in God ('sivro al HaShem'), the birthstool/reproductive organs ('ha-ani ashbir'), and the shattering of false beliefs ('shaber teshaber')
